about_the_game:
SYNOPSIS: Mr. Evans’ workday has come to an end. After a long and exhausting day, he returns to the comfort of his home, where his wonderful family awaits him. However, what at first glance appeared to be an ordinary day conceals something more sinister. A dangerous truth lies beneath the surface of his seemingly perfect life.

FAMILY MANNERS is a first-person story-driven game with psychological horror elements that delves into the darkest secrets of a traditional family.

DURATION: Family Manners has an approximate playtime of 1 hour.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Immersive Narrative: Dive into a deep and heartbreaking story, where the warmth of the home meets the darkness of its secrets.

  • Psychological Horror: A first-person psychological horror game that immerses you in a tense and unsettling atmosphere, where fear gradually builds through psychological horror and mystery.

  • Cartoon Aesthetic: A charming old cartoon aesthetic that hides a darker, more unsettling atmosphere beneath its innocent surface.

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64

short_description: Light caresses every corner of the home, and the clock marks the first heartbeats of the morning. It’s just another typical day in the wonderful life of the Evans family… right?
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
